cfg.raw_spark: An app for one-man trade businesses who forget to chase unpaid invoices until the money is a problem.
cfg.grapeRel: my friend, runs a one-woman landscaping business

answers.m2: Last month Noor finished a hedge-trimming job and didn't send the invoice for two weeks, by which point she'd forgotten the exact hours and had to guess the total.
answers.m3: My colleague Jordan pays a VA every month to chase his invoices. He set it up in February after a client stiffed him for six weeks.
answers.m4: There's a guy at my office who just has an assistant handle all his invoice chasing every month.
answers.m5: Noor uses a paper receipt book for jobs, but it has no way to flag which jobs are still unpaid, so invoices slip through unnoticed.
answers.m6: "I just want to send it and forget it," she said after the two-week one.
answers.m7: Priya only does fixed-price maintenance contracts billed automatically each month. Invoice chasing never happens to her because nothing is billed per job.
